title: LaVar Ball Answers Basketball Questions From Twitter | Tech Support | WIRED
description: LaVar Ball uses the power of Twitter to answer some common questions about basketball. Who else can give "Baller Support" better than the original baller himself, LaVar Ball? LaVar answers questions like: Who has the worst attitude in NBA history? What's the least cool NBA jersey? What's with the Golden State Warriors' facial hair?  Check out "Ball in the Family" on Facebook Watch. New episodes air Sundays.    Still haven't subscribed to WIRED on YouTube? ►► http://wrd.cm/15fP7B7     Also, check out the free WIRED channel on Roku, Apple TV, Amazon Fire TV, and Android TV. Here you can find your favorite WIRED shows and new episodes of our latest hit series Masterminds.    ABOUT WIRED  WIRED is where tomorrow is realized. Through thought-provoking stories and videos, WIRED explores the future of business, innovation, and culture.  LaVar Ball Answers Basketball Questions From Twitter | Tech Support | WIRED

asr.full_text: I'm LaVar Ball and this is Baller Support. Starting 5 with any players in NBA history, your dream team? Alright, my starting 5 NBA players of all time would be Magic Johnson at the 1. Michael Jordan at the 2. Larry Bird at the 3. Tim Duncan at the 4. And Shaquille O'Neal as the 5. Parquet bucket. Ah, ha. What is the least cool NBA Jersey you can see someone wearing? Cavs-Anthony Bennett Lakers-Dwight Howard 76ers-Andrew Bynum, others. Out of those 3, I would have to say the Cavs-Anth Anthony Bennett, because where has he been? Neil Singh. In basketball, the fans chant defense but never offense. Why is that? Scoring is important too, because offense is spontaneous, so you don't have time to say offense, offense. He already slam dunked or did a move. On defense, you can play defense for a long time. Just keep sliding your feet and deflecting passes, but on offense it's a quick move. What if you get a steal and shoot it from half court? what time you get a steal and say, off, then I shot it. So you can't say offense, offense, offense. That's why it's defense. Jason Curry, H-A-B-S. Does that stand for something too? How do you shoot a free throw? Someone tell me so I can tell the Raptors. This is ridiculous. I guess you would never know if you don't get fouled. So don't worry about the free throw game, just worry about getting in the game. Sixer Hive, compare your pickup game style to a current NBA player. My pickup game would be like Charles Barkley, cause I don't play in pickup games anymore and he's not a player anymore. So we on the same boat. Welcome to Krispy Kreme donuts. Raymond Hot take. Do the warriors have the worst collective facial hair in the NBA? Not going to answer that question because I don't look at guys' facial hair. A straw cass. Worst NBA draft suit. Photos only. The worst one has to be ... I don't know what this guys wearing, but he's got a turquoise suit on. Anybody wearing a turquoise suit is two steps below the Joker. 12 Cup? No, this says 12 Up. What's the best NBA team of the Modern Era? Stop it, I ain't even gotta look. L.A. Lakers! Why? Because they have the best ball player. Ah, Cleavis Murray. Who do you think has the worst attitude in the NBA past or present? That's a tricky one because I think everybody in the NBA has a attitude is just when you catch him at the right time. If you think a guy had a bad attitude and he winning all time, he gonna be good. But as soon as he lose a couple of games and you'd be like, well what do you think was the problem for the losing? Then he gonna be like, you mother, you know why we lost, hey! It's gonna be like that, you mother, you know why we lost. Hey! It's going to be like that. You just got to catch him at the right time. Dennis Smith Jr., what is the best NBA ringer? Again, Staples Center. Christie Flock. Who has the worst her in the NBA? The question should have been, who has the best hair? Because everybody got that crazy hair new now. I don't know what it's looking like. Looked like they just woke up and they think that's fresh. My son has that too, but maybe it's the culture these days. It's like, you know, if it's nappy you happy. T. Raul! I think I would be a great tv personality. How do I get started in the field of work? Well, I think you need to go out to your local neighborhood and start interviewing everybody on the street That's a good way to get started So how do I get to be on the talk show Where all I do is talk about my life By Catherine Hall Hmm First of all your life better be interesting So I suggest if you have a boyfriend And he ain't ask questions Guess what don't nobody care about your life On a scale from 1 to absolutely effing baller, how baller do I look? The dude called big sexy. You know what? When you're wearing the all white suit with a camouflage shirt, I don't care what nobody says, you a baller just to come out with that on. You can't tell him nothing. He walked down the street and said you're not a big baller, he gotta be a big baller cause he the one who put on it. Ain't for me, but if you can rock it like that, you a big baller, shoot. Gilbert Rod, seriously wondering how hard it would be to drop out and be a baller. The dropping out part is very easy but being the baller is gonna be the hard part. So I'll let you figure that one out Krcr purgatory I got some wicked discount coupons and in need of some new fresh cakes Can you please help me decide which one? Do you like better? pics below He has two of them One looks like a jogger and the other one looks like a casual shoe. The difference between a jogger and a casual shoe? Take the casual, cause I think you do less running. Too hot. What a name. How do I even win an argument? The best way to win an argument, turn around and go the other way. Who you gonna argue with? You won. GG guy I'm too broke to be a big baller man, how about you hook me up with some heat? So check it out, let's stop worrying about being a big baller and worrying about heat and let's just be cool. This is Baller Support and I've supported the baller all I can for all this time, and until the next questions, we out.
